title: Chapter 1354 - 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 4)
content:
Chapter 1354 - 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 4)

Chapter 1354: Chapter 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 4)

For instance, what about living supplies, etc.?

As long as there is an exchange with the outside world, clues will be left behind.

Thus, there exists the possibility of being discovered.

After the establishment of the Greater Yan Dynasty, Lin Yuan will found an intelligence organization specifically responsible for searching for the true Da Feng Emperor.

"Yes."

Everyone immediately nodded.

They were not surprised by Lin Yuan’s search for the remnants of the Da Feng Dynasty.

Basically, every successive ruler would cleanse the previous dynasty’s royal descendants.

First, to eliminate hidden threats.

Second, because reaching the point of rebellion surely means irreconcilable conflicts with the dynasty itself, such as deep-seated grievances.

...

The Da Feng Dynasty was overthrown.

The Greater Yan Dynasty was established.

The alternation between the new and old dynasties did not significantly impact the common people of the ninety-nine prefectures.

Primarily because the transition of rulers was so silent and discreet.

Lin Yuan spent seventy years planning and scheming, successfully infiltrating the entire Da Feng Dynasty cleanly.

The transfer of power across the prefectures was exceptionally smooth and within Lin Yuan’s expectations.

Many commoners only heard the news of the uprising one day and the announcement of the newly established Greater Yan Dynasty the next day.

First Year of Great Yan.

The Ancestor ascended the throne, ruling the world.

Within the palace.

The white-haired Third Uncle looked bewilderedly at the magnificent palace and pavilions before him.

Next to him stood Lin Yuan, smiling.

"This is..."

The white-haired Third Uncle fell silent, his expression incredulous.

The Da Feng Dynasty was really overthrown.

The Sect Leader’s son established a new dynasty called ’Greater Yan’?

This, this, this...

The white-haired Third Uncle felt a bit terrified.

Though he knew long ago that Lin Yuan would inevitably soar to great heights.

But to overthrow the Da Feng Dynasty?

And establish a new dynasty?

"Young Master, am I not dreaming?"

The white-haired Third Uncle murmured.

"Naturally not a dream."

Lin Yuan said with a beaming smile.

Currently, the only person he could call family in this cyclical world was Third Uncle.

"Now is the First Year of Great Yan."

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

"Yes, First Year of Great Yan, I’m not dreaming."

Third Uncle grinned and said, "I didn’t expect that I, Lu San, could see the day when the Young Master establishes a new dynasty."

"It’s just a pity that Big Brother can’t see it."

Third Uncle’s expression darkened, referring to the former Red Lotus Sect Leader.

Who was the father of the body Lin Yuan now inhabited.

If it weren’t for the Red Lotus Sect Leader sacrificing his life to hold back the Tao Suppression Department’s Taoists back then.

He and Third Uncle would never have had the chance to escape.

"Once I break through the time loop, I might try to ’resurrect’ everyone."

Lin Yuan thought in his heart.

He didn’t have confidence in this matter.

After all, the time loop, in theory, was a world formed under the operation of supreme rules.

No one was certain if the lives within had ever truly existed.

The Thirteen-tiered Temporal Beings he’d encountered never attempted to resurrect lives from within the time loop.

Within the time loop world, everything experienced was like a dream.

The Thirteen-tiered Temporal Beings who had cultivated for an eternity were often indifferent to related emotions such as familial ties.

But Lin Yuan was different.

From his first steps on the path of evolution to now.

It hadn’t been that long.

He still valued relationships relatively.

If resurrecting within the time loop was a simple matter.

Lin Yuan would genuinely consider doing it.

...

A month later.

The white-haired Third Uncle passed away.

Lin Yuan couldn’t do anything about it, even though he tried to smooth Third Uncle’s vitality flows.

But Third Uncle couldn’t master the flow of vitality as perfectly as Lin Yuan.

Living to nearly one hundred and thirty years was already quite astonishing.

"All who could be considered my family, those from the past, are gone."

Lin Yuan thought silently in his heart, "Only you remain, Da Feng Emperor."

Now Lin Yuan, in this world, only had the old acquaintance of the Da Feng Emperor left.

...

Two months later.

Beneath the former capital of the Da Feng Empire.

Here was the most abundant Earth Fire Cave in the ninety-nine prefectures.

A holy land coveted by all crafting masters.

Before the establishment of Greater Yan, this Earth Fire Cave was controlled by the previous dynasty.

Now this Earth Fire Cave was sealed by numerous Imperial Guards.

The former crafting masters were tremblingly kneeling.

At this moment.

A figure slowly walked in.

It was Lin Yuan.

"Greetings, Your Majesty."

"Greetings, Your Majesty."

All the crafting masters kowtowed in fear.

"Rise."

Lin Yuan did not make things difficult for these crafting masters and glanced around, "I remember all the Original Divine Gold collected by the Da Feng Dynasty is stored here, right?"

Original Divine Gold is the hardest metal of heaven and earth, and it was what Da Feng Ancestor intended to use to forge nine cauldrons.

Because of its hardness, melting it would take enormous time, with a fist-sized chunk of Original Fine Gold taking at least a century to melt fully.

Hence, every time the Da Feng Dynasty collected a piece of Original Divine Gold, it was immediately sent to this Earth Fire Cave for melting, in preparation to quickly forge the nine cauldrons when enough was gathered.

"Your Majesty, I don’t know....."

The lead crafting master was trembling, "Since I took over this Earth Fire Cave, I haven’t found any Original Divine Gold."

"Is that so?"

Lin Yuan glanced at the person, and with a cause-and-effect relationship, he began to observe their past timeline.

After confirming that the person wasn’t lying, Lin Yuan continued to ask, "Who was in charge of this Earth Fire Cave before you?"

Before leaving to establish the Greater Yan Dynasty, Lin Yuan began thoroughly investigating any traces related to the true Da Feng Emperor within the palace.

By observing the timelines, Lin Yuan quickly noticed the ’absence’ of Original Fine Gold.

No doubt about it.

All Original Fine Gold collected by the Da Feng Dynasty had vanished.

"It was, it was my grandfather..."

An older crafting master mustered the courage to speak.

"Your grandfather... where is he now?"

Lin Yuan asked.

"He disappeared, my grandfather vanished suddenly seventy years ago."

This crafting master truthfully said, "Back then I was young, and this is what I heard from my father; shortly afterward, my father disappeared too."

"Seventy years ago?"

Lin Yuan squinted.

Combining other information he gathered, he could almost confirm.

The disappearance of all Original Fine Gold of the Da Feng Dynasty was related to the true Da Feng Emperor he sought.

Because the disappearance of the Original Divine Gold occurred around seventy years ago, when all the crafting masters of this Earth Fire Cave also vanished.

It wasn’t until thirty years ago that this Earth Fire Cave was reactivated and new crafting masters entered.

Furthermore, as the Original Divine Gold came with Da Feng Ancestor’s edict, who else but the reigning Da Feng Emperor could use it?

"Da Feng Emperor, what did you forge with so much Original Divine Gold?"

Lin Yuan pondered silently, while several speculations formed in his mind.

These speculations gave Lin Yuan new insight into the true Da Feng Emperor who had disappeared.

Returning to the palace.

Lin Yuan then issued another order.

A reward for any large piece of Original Fine Gold found, bestowing a title and rewarding ten thousand gold coins.

Meanwhile, Lin Yuan himself began traveling the land, searching for traces of Original Divine Gold.

The disappearance of all the Original Divine Gold from the Earth Fire Cave was at the hands of the true Da Feng Emperor.

There was definitely a significant connection between the two.

If the missing Original Divine Gold could be found.

He estimated that he could find the Da Feng Emperor who vanished fifty years ago.

...

Time passed slowly.

In the blink of an eye, eighty years had passed.
